verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the platform lets ops configure accepted documents by issuing country and document type (docs-8) and supports document/NFC verification (docs-17, docs-20, docs-25), implying broad document coverage, but no published list of supported countries or document type breadth (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) is cited. missing for 10: a published supported-countries/document-types list, explicit enumeration of document types like residence permits, and independent corroboration of breadth.
